description: Floodplain (Nilotic) selection: the Towns & Towers Nilotic houses with roles assigned by Aaron, editable restyled drafts for the storehouse, fishery pool, well, watchtower and three market tiers, and two Polynesian farms from the donor gallery.
source_policy: Source captures, display templates and edited captures remain private under run/. Only authoring metadata and provenance are tracked publicly.

village_biome.note: Vanilla swamp is reserved for a separate Swamp village. Hot riverbank sites may join later once site selection can see rivers.

coordinate_system.amenities: relative to the gallery origin of each exhibit; y -1 is the captured ground course
coordinate_system.capture_from: world position of the capture box corner (two blocks of padding, ground course included)
coordinate_system.capture_bounds: padded review bounds, not final building envelopes

ground_policy.description: A patchy earthen ground course (packed mud, mud, coarse dirt, rooted dirt) lies under every house footprint at capture y -1; Aaron rounded several corners by hand. Author it as the template ground layer with sink 1.

identity_policy.beds: Every bed is a village-colour slot: couple units take the primary colour, single beds alternate primary then secondary within a building.
identity_policy.couple_beds: Two bed heads side by side with the same facing are one couple unit and share one colour.
identity_policy.banners: White banners are village banners (centre and watchtower). Banners of any other colour are decoration and stay as authored.
identity_policy.carpet: The centre green carpets become the primary colour.

container_policy: Barrels and chests are shared work storage unless a bedroom pairing is authored later.

planting.reason: The wood loop refuses mangrove propagules because grown mangroves leave roots on the stand.

allay_quartermasters.rule: Any village: the quartermaster takes on nearby allays as auxiliary helpers the way guards recruit golems; storehouse-born allays wait at the storehouse note block until adopted. No second storehouse tier: more storehouses instead, all served by every keeper.
allay_quartermasters.note_block: Aaron placed a note block in the storehouse draft.

restyle_policy.method: block-type substitution through VillageTemplateExport overrides; every block keeps its orientation and properties

walls.palette: decisions.wall_palette; mirrors the arid gate-frame and candle rules of the wood wall generator
walls.approval: Aaron reviewed the restyled row on 2026-09-10 and corrected one gatehouse roof cell; the captures hold that state.

decisions.lumberjack_tree: jungle sapling on dirt at the dead-bush spot
decisions.floors: patchy earthen ground course laid under every house footprint in the gallery (packed mud, mud, coarse dirt, rooted dirt); recorded in floors-20260910.json for the sink-1 capture; Aaron rounded the corners of several house floors; mine NA01.2 and the watchtower plate NA03.4 converted afterwards

draft_restyles.NA03.3 well: cobblestone to andesite, mossy cobblestone to mud bricks
draft_restyles.NA03.4 watchtower: acacia to mangrove logs and planks, spruce slabs, stairs and fences, jungle trapdoors, green beds
draft_restyles.NA03.2 fishery pool: sand to mud, acacia leaves to mangrove leaves

decisions.market_restyle: cut sandstone to mud bricks, sandstone stairs to mud brick stairs, acacia fences to spruce, acacia logs to mangrove, potted cactus and dead bush to fern; wool, carpets and banners kept as identity slots
decisions.market_edit: Aaron removed one extra orange carpet from the market drafts; captures refreshed afterwards

wall_palette.status: approved by Aaron 2026-09-10 after one hand correction; the five sections are captured in the selection record
wall_palette.body: minecraft:mud_bricks for posts, deck, wall body and tower shell (every stripped oak log / oak plank cell)
wall_palette.steps_and_slabs: minecraft:mud_brick_stairs / minecraft:mud_brick_slab keep the authored facing and half
wall_palette.railing: minecraft:mud_brick_wall in place of every fence (mud brick walls, not mangrove fences)
wall_palette.trapdoor: minecraft:jungle_trapdoor keeps the authored facing, half and open state
wall_palette.frame: minecraft:muddy_mangrove_roots on the gatehouse uprights (x 6 and 10, z 1 and 3, y < 5) and the y 5 beams, mirroring the chiseled stone trim of the arid WallPalette
wall_palette.light: minecraft:brown_candle clusters (candles = 2 + floorMod(31x + 17z + y, 3), lit) wherever a standing lantern stood; inward roof lanterns removed like the arid palette
wall_palette.hanging_lanterns: the four lanterns hanging under the gatehouse arch stay lanterns
wall_palette.runtime: becomes the FLOODPLAIN case of WallPalette.forStyle once the floodplain VillageStyle lands
wall_palette.post_tops: a log standing on end at y 5 (the post tops at x 5 and x 16, z 2) is a post, not a beam, and stays mud bricks; only the lying logs of the roof rim and the four uprights are roots, as isGateFrame classifies them
